fixed.climate: a small sunny clearing in the dream wood, warm and still (geography.json LOC-mushroom-clearing)

dream_design.flora: buttercups, meadow cranesbill, ox-eye daisies and harebells grown to towering height at Alice's three-inch scale, their stems drawn in long, curving whiplash lines; grass blades arch over her like a vaulted nave, so the clearing reads as a green cathedral of stems around the mushroom
dream_design.ornament_cues: the mushroom cap is the scene's halo roundel, a circular disc framing the Caterpillar from below; hookah smoke rises in slow ribbon-curls, Mucha hair-line arabesques that hang in the still air; the gills under the cap give a natural radial fan pattern
dream_design.palette: pastel-and-gold: buttercup gold and warm cream in the flowers, soft lilac-blue smoke, sage and pale jade leaf-light; gold rim-light on petal edges (lighting takes these as colour targets only)
dream_design.seasonal_guard: July meadow flowers only; no spring bluebells, primroses or blossom
dream_design.reason: Buttercups, flowers and the mushroom are explicit (ch004-p40..p41). Species, line treatment and palette are designed to WR-010 and the user style reference (refs/style/alice.jpeg: giant caterpillar in an Art Nouveau nave), translated into a living, photographed clearing.

fixed.ground_and_flora: summer grass and buttercups, other July meadow flowers, and the one large mushroom; wood edge in full green leaf around
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from a sunny patch of grass, flowers and field mushrooms in a copse near home, where schoolroom recitations come back to a drowsy child. It is the same warm, windless July afternoon as the waking bank. The stillness is why the hookah smoke hangs in the air.
